oliver: heads-up: deploy-bot just paused promotion for tag=release-2026.09.10. Several staging builds produced different binaries (failing integration smoke).

deploy-bot: "promotion paused for tag=release-2026.09.10, reason=ci/bazel-remote-cache-corrupt-output x2 failures"

ci-baz: build logs show action outputs from remote cache with mismatched checksums: expected=sha256:aa11bb got=sha256:cc22dd for //pkg/server:bin. Rebuilding locally produces aa11bb, so cache returned bad object.

ken: any recent changes to the remote cache backend or object storage?

sre-jamie: S3 reports a recent rewrite job ran last night that replaced objects to change encryption headers. It looks like some small objects got reuploaded under the same key while indexer was running, causing a brief window where GET returned partial content.

qa-rita: failing integration: startup crash with missing embedded assets in the binary. That's consistent with a truncated artifact from cache.

oliver: change window ends in ~70 minutes. Options: (A) pin to previous prod image release-2026.09.01 and cut now, (B) trigger a full rebuild of the release tag (adds ~30m), (C) wait for cache repair and re-promote. Which is fastest?

release-mgr: full rebuild might meet the window but depends on queued builders. Pin is safest. If we pin, create a postmortem and file ENG-4788 for remote-cache reconciliation.

ci-baz: quick mitigation: invalidate affected keys and trigger selective rebuild of //pkg/server:bin across canaries; that should be ~20-25m if queue is free. But if object-store rewrite continues, rebuilt artifacts could still get corrupted when written back.

sre-jamie: I'll pause the rewrite job and validate object checksums across the affected prefix. ENG-4788 created. Will also trigger immediate cache-consistency check.

oliver: decision: pin to release-2026.09.01 to guarantee the cut. We'll schedule a controlled rebuild and re-promote after ENG-4788 completes. ken, please draft the release note blurb.

ken: posted draft in #release-notes-drafts: "Production cut pinned to 2026.09.01 due to remote-cache corrupted action outputs in staging; follow-up ENG-4788 opened for S3 rewrite and cache reconciliation."

release-mgr: invoking deploy-bot: `promote --image=release-2026.09.01 --reason="bazel-remote-cache-corrupt-outputs"`

deploy-bot: Promotion queued.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Production now points to release-2026.09.01. :white_check_mark:

qa-rita: ENG-4788 created and assigned to sre-jamie. Rerun scheduled for 08:30 UTC tomorrow with selective rebuild + cache invalidation flags. Close thread after ENG-4788 has initial triage. :lock:
